# vendor/flight-web

a32x-cbt's own `flight/web` files that the page imports, at 21252be: the KDFW drawing (`airport.js`, `airport-layout.js`, `scene-math.js`, `lights.js`, `data/kdfw.json`) and the sky's air (`atmosphere.js`, `haze.js`). By the same owner as the sketch: GPLv3 in a32x-cbt's `flight/web`, MIT here (`../../NOTICE.md`). Changed only by `tools/standalone.mjs`, which copied them and set their licence markers; their sources are in `docs/provenance.md`, 1f and 1g.
